name: Torque
text: Risk: Mythos 5’s edge is unproven in EXCAVA’s pipeline—Fable 5 already runs stable; switching risks breaking downstream tasks for a marginal gain. Better alternative: test Mythos 5 on a 1% slice of EXCAVA’s data first; if the slice shows ≥0.5% quality lift, proceed—else stick with Fable 5. name: Gearbox
text:
Choose to run a **blind A/B test** of **Claude Mythos 5** against Fable 5 on a 2% slice of EXCAVA’s data before any full switch. The test is cheap, fast, and gives us hard proof of Mythos 5’s real-world edge—no assumptions, no risk to the live pipeline. If it hits even 0.5% quality lift, we switch; if not, we keep Fable 5 and move on. Trade-off: we delay the full upgrade by a day, but that’s cheaper than rolling back a broken change.
